summary: Vertical Aerospace Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on October 16, 2026, disclosing that its subsidiary Vertical Aerospace Group Limited entered new long-term supplier agreements on October 15, 2026 with ANH Structure Co., Ltd. and Northrop Grumman LITEF GmbH for systems on its Valo eVTOL aircraft. No securities, prices, stakes, or board recommendations are involved. The filing furnishes a related press release and incorporates the disclosure by reference into existing Form F-3 registration statements. This is a routine commercial supply-contract disclosure, not a special situation; watch only for certification and production milestones, not deal arbitrage.
